question.text: At what rate is GST currently applicable on Management Fees charged by a Cat I/II AIF's Investment Manager, per Indian tax rules referenced in Chapter 6?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 6 (section 6.3.4) states GST @ 18% applies on Management Fees, Trusteeship Fees, and fees to external service providers (administrators, custodians, auditors, legal advisors). The Trap: A and C are other GST slabs; D confuses AIFs' pass-through status for INCOME TAX (Section 115UB) with GST applicability on services. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests this. Same rate applies to PMS fees (XXI-B) and Investment Adviser fees (X-A/X-B) — 18%. Manager's Pro-Tip: AIFs generally CANNOT recover GST as Input Tax Credit since the fund does not provide taxable output services — so GST is a sunk cost. Factor this into the all-in expense ratio you quote LPs (add ~36 bps on a 2% management fee).
